title: Homework set: upper and lower bounds
subject: Mathematics
unit: Spring 1: Revision cycle 1: Number, algebra, sequences, graphs
source: Written for mathematics/y11 lesson 56 (Complete the portal's bounds set (6 questions) and add any errors to your repair list.)
intro: 6 questions. Calculator allowed. Show your working. Mark it with the mark scheme and add any errors to your repair list.

questions.q: A length is 12 cm to the nearest centimetre. Write down the error interval for the length l.
A mass is 3.7 kg correct to 1 decimal place. Write down the error interval for the mass m.
A rectangle measures 6.4 cm by 3.8 cm, both correct to 1 d.p. Work out the upper bound of its area.
A runner covers 54 m, to the nearest metre, in 6.2 s, correct to 1 d.p. Work out the upper bound of the average speed. Give your answer to 3 significant figures.
a = 7.2 and b = 2.6, both correct to 1 d.p. Work out the lower bound of a − b.
A block has mass 250 g to the nearest 10 g and volume 32 cm³ to the nearest cm³. Work out the lower bound of its density. Give your answer to 3 significant figures.
